headline.text: L2 ML3 demolder plate broke at 10:25 requiring emergency weld repair—line back by 11:50—and L3 Truffle stopped *5 times overnight* on equipment and temperature issues but all cleared by morning.

per_plant_summary.L1: Sollich 2 ran a smooth milk-to-dark changeover and completed the 12,210-case BET Dark order by 10:01. Sollich 4 had a brief tapioca temperature delay. An extension cord for a heated tote sparked when pinched—removed and replacement ordered.
per_plant_summary.L2: ML3 demolder sliding plate broke at 10:25 with foreign material concerns; maintenance welded the plate and replaced a bearing, line back at 11:50. FFS had two brief bag-folding stops, both cleared same shift. ML2 depositor temps are slowly rising—flagged for weekend monitoring.
per_plant_summary.L3: Truffle line stopped five times overnight: Cavanna overheated and tripped on damaged cable (fixed 17:34), guillotine faulted twice (E-stop reset, power cycle), and low chocolate temperature required two reheats—all cleared by 03:05. ML1 ran with two centerline adjustments off spec. ML4 depositor 3 missing bolt; auger weld scheduled Monday.

notes.text: Sollich 1 down for end-of-week level 2 clean as scheduled.
Fernando Flores installed new ASCO valve on PTL overnight.
ML1 and MFM completed level 2 cleans; post-op ATP passed.

resolved.title: Heated tote extension cord sparked
resolved.summary: Extension cord pinched and sparked when warehouse worker pulled it out at 13:59; cord removed, replacement ordered.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 13:59 — "We removed it and will order a replacement" (William Lopez).

resolved.title: IMS pallet wrapper lost power
resolved.summary: Wrapper by IMS desks lost power at 19:47; Caleb York investigated and restored.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 19:54 — "It has the power" (Caleb York).

resolved.title: ML3 demolder sliding plate broke, bolt lost
resolved.summary: Plate cracked and linear bearing failed at 10:25; maintenance welded plate and installed new bearing, metal detector tested for foreign material risk, line restored by 11:50.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 11:50 — "Line is back up" after weld repair and bearing replacement (Alex Mendoza).

resolved.title: FFS bag folder bottom sealing issues
resolved.summary: Bags coming out of folder with bottom defects at 15:22; maintenance adjusted folder, line running at 15:26.

resolved.title: FFS double-layered fabric on back seal
resolved.summary: Film feeding issue causing double layers on back seal at 17:17; remedied by 17:54.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 17:54 — "This has been remedied and the line is running" (Mathew Draper).

resolved.title: Truffle Cavanna 2 overheated, cable damaged
resolved.summary: Cavanna tripped on overheating at 14:04, exposed cable found causing breaker trips and sensor failure; cable replaced and rerouted by 17:34, cooling system investigation underway.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 17:34 — "Cute Cavanna is now up and running I replaced the damaged cable with a new one and redid how it runs through the machine to prevent this from happening again" (Nathan Ruiz).

resolved.title: Truffle guillotine stopped, ultrasonic fault
resolved.summary: Guillotine failed at 21:14 due to E-stop fault, then again at 22:36 with ultrasonic not working; E-stop reset and power cycle of main cabinet restored function.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 22:10 — "Truffle line it's back and running good. There's was a fault with an E-stop so I reset it" (Efrain Rodriguez); second stop cleared with "power cycled the main electrical cabinet" (Kavin Ayala).

resolved.title: Truffle enrober low chocolate temperature
resolved.summary: Line stopped twice (01:35 and 02:21) when chocolate temperature dropped too low and pipes built up; reheat and tempering cycles required.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 03:05 — "Line started at 3:05" after tempering restarted at 02:50 (TruffleLine Enrober).

resolved.title: Truffle Cavanna 1 belt sliding off
resolved.summary: Last belt on Cavanna 1 sliding to the side at 03:53; maintenance recentered and adjusted, 3 trays accumulated.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 03:58 — "Belt was recentered and adjusted, we accumulated 3 trays from it. Cavanna is running again!" (TruffleLine FW).

needs_attention.title: Item 10231 material shortage, 1000 lbs short
needs_attention.summary: Luis Pino flagged at 10:43 that 5-shift run will be 1000 lbs short; 19,800 lbs in order status, shipment due but vendor whereabouts unknown.
needs_attention.status: Martin Carlos following up with vendor as of 14:36; shipment due today but location unconfirmed, no update in window.

needs_attention.title: ML2 depositor temps slowly rising
needs_attention.summary: PTL and temper unit temps good, but depositor temps trending up slowly as of 07:00; Gustavo flagged for weekend monitoring.
needs_attention.status: Tempering devices hitting temps but depositor temps slowly coming up as of 07:00; may need check over weekend.

needs_attention.title: ML4 depositor 3 missing bolt, auger damaged
needs_attention.summary: Depositor 3 slider cap bolt missing at 10:02; damaged auger needs weld and seized pin still not found, repair scheduled Monday morning.
needs_attention.status: Auger to be welded Monday morning, still searching for seized pin as of 10:23 (Nathan Ruiz).

needs_attention.title: ML1 two centerline adjustments off spec
needs_attention.summary: Flow-wrap reported two adjustments outside centerlines at shift start; tracked through day, still off spec at 22:24 shift end but within tolerance.
needs_attention.status: Ended shift with same two adjustments outside centerlines at 22:24; being tracked but operation continued.
